name: slop-factory
//: Two TypeScripts. typescript-native (7, the Go port) type-checks every root workspace: their typecheck scripts run its bin/tsc by path (slop-haus/e2e_playwright_ts, outside the workspaces with its own lockfile, type-checks on its own typescript 6). typescript stays on 6 for the code that needs the JS compiler API, which 7's package does not export (its main entry is only the version): openapi-typescript (generate_api_client.sh), Storybook's react-docgen-typescript, cosmiconfig for stylelint, and our own tools/import_boundaries.mjs, unstyled_story.ts and story_coverage.ts.

Keep typescript on 6 and typescript-native on 7, and every workspace's typescript range the same as this one, until those consumers support 7's API; .github/dependabot.yml ignores typescript majors for the same reason.
